crossRefs.note: Let the priests also, who come near to Yahweh, sanctify themselves, lest Yahweh break out on them.”
Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God. Aaron came with all the elders of Israel…
Yahweh called to Moses, and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,
“ ‘If his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings, if he offers it from the herd, whether male or female, he shall…
“ ‘This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which one shall offer to Yahweh:

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: He sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of cattle to Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Then he sent out some young men of Israel, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as peace offerings to the LORD.
translations.kjv: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the LORD.
translations.asv: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt-offerings, and sacrificed peace-offerings of oxen unto Jehovah.
